summary: Critical-section-guarded stream write wrapper. Acquires the stream-buffer lock via StreamBufferLockViaCriticalSection, reads a flag via sub_58E41B, performs the actual write via sub_58D04D(a1, a2, a3), conditionally clears struct fields via ClearStructFieldsIfFlagSet when the flag is set, releases the lock via AddressRangeCriticalSectionLeave, and returns the write result. Called by DebugLogWrite and BufferWriteWithStringLengthCheck.

operations.description: Acquire the stream-buffer critical section via StreamBufferLockViaCriticalSection(a1) before writing.
v3 = sub_58E41B(a1); read a flag/state value that gates the later struct-field clearing.
v4 = sub_58D04D(a1, a2, a3); perform the actual write of a2/a3 against the buffer owned by a1 and keep its result.
ClearStructFieldsIfFlagSet(v3, a1); if the flag from sub_58E41B is set, clear struct fields on the object a1.
Release the stream-buffer critical section via AddressRangeCriticalSectionLeave(a1).
Return v4, the result produced by sub_58D04D.
